probableCause: Shared mutable state between tests: overriddenRateIsUsed sets the USD rate to 1.10 and nothing restores it, so defaultRateForUsd sees 1.10 when it runs after it. The failure depends on test order.
evidence: The actual value 1.10 is exactly what overriddenRateIsUsed writes with ExchangeRates.override.
Neither test resets the rate after use.
ExchangeRates is used through static methods, so its state is shared across tests.

possibleSolutions.solution: Restore the original rate in an @AfterEach (or add a reset method to ExchangeRates) so each test starts from the default.
tradeoffs: A test-only reset method widens the production API.
